system_thesis_interpretation: The exact composite v8 protocol remains the same lower-bracket writer assay as v7: one adapter-free four-task lived prefix is executed once and cloned into H and E; E alone receives the fixed rank-16 q/v action-cloning writer, both lives continue over the same four acquisition tasks, E is rebuilt cumulatively once more, and four fixed syntactic targets are evaluated under H, E_ON, and the same final E public state with the adapter absent. The intervention, model capabilities, task allocation, eligible training rows, target panel, score definitions, and single-manifest execution are unchanged. V8 changes authority, lifecycle, evidence, and interpretation boundaries rather than the empirical experiment. Its legitimate product is an audited description of one exact model/manifest/trajectory/writer/panel realization and, at most, a documented heuristic for choosing a later assay. It cannot establish a population effect, semantic generalization, functional correctness, action-cloning sufficiency, a mechanism, generic harm or efficacy, continual learning, intelligent sleep, or a paper claim. The v7 concerns are closed at the architecture level without adding an arm or widening the science claim; the claim boundary is narrowed to what the existing design can actually support.
graph_delta_interpretation: V6S8_AUTHORITY_AND_LIFECYCLE makes the pre-run graph executable without opening a scientific feedback path. Exact architecture ratification may authorize only two CPU/no-model sealer invocations and only the declared URI, bitcode, reset, baseline, eligibility, rejection, and provenance evidence; model-conditioned target actions, target cells, target result opening or use, training, and GPU execution remain gated by the later exact run ratification. Global termination on any ordinary pre-panel failure prevents a surviving branch from becoming an unregistered alternative life or evidence suffix. V6S8_LITERAL_REPORT removes the unsupported promotion from finite values to effect categories or diagnoses. V6S8_PROPORTIONATE_AUDIT keeps the evidentiary edge exact by binding discrete row/token/mask/update/configuration provenance and the one realized publication and mount, while expressly avoiding a new floating-point reproducibility experiment. The resulting report edge is coherent: immutable actual-run evidence reaches the auditor; target results never return to a model, life, memory, writer, row-selection decision, or tuning decision; and only status-permitted literal values leave quarantine after T05.
loop_delta_interpretation: The wake/sleep science remains v7's common-prefix fork and two declared E sleep boundaries. The clarified lifecycle is one indivisible registered manifest before panel entry: the first ordinary reset, model, process, training, publication, or mount failure stops every remaining branch and sleep as RUN_INCOMPLETE; any integrity-class failure stops immediately with precedence and numeric suppression. Only after final-panel entry may an ordinary cell failure be sealed missing while the other already-frozen cold cells continue, producing PANEL_INCOMPLETE and no aggregate D values. This distinction prevents branch-dependent salvage while retaining useful raw completed cells from a panel whose conditions were fixed before outcomes. The final audit independently reconstructs all discrete state, sample, schedule, cell, score, and status facts from immutable evidence. It checks the frozen training configuration and per-update telemetry plus exact adapter publication/tensor-inventory/mount hashes, but does not retrain or demand bitwise floating-point equality. That is sufficient provenance for the one realized intervention and is consistent with the retained single-build, manifest-pinned-but-not-bitwise-deterministic protocol.
claim_delta_interpretation: The literal claim limit is scientifically coherent if applied exactly. Following a passing T05 audit, release only the registered status and the raw action/count curves and reduced rational F, D_HE, and D_ONOFF values permitted by that status; describe each available rational comparison only as positive, negative, or exactly zero. D_HE is a total treated-life comparison that includes earlier adapter-mediated actions, the resulting E public state and selected data, and the final mount. D_ONOFF is a paired final-mount comparison conditional on the same realized final E snapshot, but later within-cell divergence may mediate subsequent action and score differences. Saying whether an action or registered score differed means only literal inequality between the registered paired outputs under adapter-present and adapter-absent assignments in this manifest. It is not an effect-size category, threshold crossing, population estimate, semantic-transfer result, causal-mechanism diagnosis, or general claim. Exact zero means only equality on the registered finite values; positive and negative signs mean only higher and lower realized registered scores. RUN_INCOMPLETE and PANEL_INCOMPLETE are operational statuses rather than scientific zeros, and INTEGRITY_FAILURE permits no numeric release. This closure preserves the useful measurements while retiring every unsupported sufficiency, poisoning, interference, generic harm, weakness, no-effect, and transferable-structure conclusion.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The complete matrix is consistent with the narrow claim. CPU_FIXTURES_SEAL permits only synthetic fixture state and the two authorized no-model environment measurements; those measurements are selection/provenance inputs rather than learned target actions or results. COMMON_PREFIX has no condition or adapter object and exposes only canonical public packet state. FORKED_ACQUISITION_SLEEP exposes branch-local public packets and below-prompt adapter effects, while row membership, labels, optimizer state, and telemetry stay offline. FINAL_PANEL uses the designated sealed snapshot and adapter/NONE assignment, but every target receipt and result stays hidden from all later model calls and cannot update memory, a life, a writer, training data, or a choice. POSTRUN_AUDIT is the first point where packet, condition, training, mount, and target evidence is jointly visible. This supports finite application-level target-feedback exclusion and exact-run auditability, not machine-wide noninterference or semantic target independence.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V6S8_T01 must use a genuinely separate CPU oracle to lock literal packet bytes, strict action parsing, all reducer and six-slot transitions, immediate-improvement memory, exact task-4 clone semantics, first post-fork packet equality before the E mount, rational score/status rules, and the A2 lifecycle at every pre-panel failure point, including proof that no forbidden branch, sleep, or panel receipt follows the failure. V6S8_T02 must independently derive eligibility, hash checking, earliest-event deduplication, row-hash/copy order, literal tokenizer arrays and suffix-only masks, update indices/count, q_proj/v_proj inventory, toy AdamW/clipping order, finite checks, and publication/mount failure behavior; its value is unique implementation and provenance closure, not evidence that the writer learns or a numerical replay of GPU training. For both tests, author/path/hash metadata alone is insufficient: T04 must verify static independently derived expectations and that no production serializer, reducer, parser, row selector, mask builder, or update planner produced the relevant oracle results. V6S8_T03 is exactly two fresh CPU/no-model executions of the frozen selection/reset algorithm. Byte-identical ordered 8/4 manifests, twelve unique URI and bitcode identities, and exact repeated Autophase/I0/IOz establish reproducible target-blind syntactic selection only; they do not establish semantic independence, functional correctness, or any learned target result. V6S8_T04 is the pre-GPU veto gate over the exact composite bytes, implementation, independent T01/T02 provenance, T03 evidence, lifecycle table, receipt and telemetry schemas, final run manifest and command, finite visibility paths, synthetic canary inherited from v7, and quantitative 7B GH200 memory/storage/time budget. Reviewer approval cannot authorize a run; it only permits one exact manifest to be presented for separate human run ratification. V6S8_T05 is the sole result-release gate. A fresh reviewer reconstructs every actual packet, action, state, memory, eligible row, token/mask, scheduled update, frozen configuration, publication, tensor inventory, mount, cell, reduced rational score, aggregate availability, and status, verifies the no-target-feedback path and legal stop suffix, and does so without floating-point retraining. A verified integrity mismatch yields INTEGRITY_FAILURE and suppresses all numbers. Collectively T01--T05 are adequate for this one audited descriptive pilot and deliberately provide no replication, semantic holdout validation, control writer, inferential power, or broader learning evidence.
assumptions: The operative protocol is the exact v7 protocol at SHA-256 6ddec2537cabcd4228a1d3144988f3483ba1e86ecc6be85fe5c82301449836b1 plus only the explicit v8 superseding amendments; historical before-text in change.json is not an active scientific permission.

The phrase that mounting the adapter changed an action or score is used only for literal paired inequality in the registered E_ON versus E_OFF cells conditional on the same sealed E snapshot, including any within-cell state mediation after an initial action divergence.

T01's coverage of every failure status includes each ordinary pre-panel phase and the absence of every prohibited execution suffix required by A2; T04 must veto an implementation or fixture set that omits that coverage.

The later exact run manifest will freeze all model, tokenizer, chat-template, system, runtime, generation, environment, task/cell order, training, telemetry, publication, mount, command, seed, dtype, initialization, gradient-checkpointing, hardware, and receipt identities needed by T04 and T05.

Every target cell begins from a fresh byte clone of its assigned sealed H or E public snapshot and a cold environment reset, and no cell-local action, state, or result crosses to another cell or to a writer.
A T05 reviewer may validate and release the appropriate registered failure status as an audited result, but no provenance or integrity mismatch can release a numeric value.
